label: 1-2 steps after a d in the original phase, mid-to-late positions (t=4-7)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original-input phase (97% of mass), with a little on the delimiter step and never during copy. Firing is concentrated at t=4-7 (peak t=5-6) and requires the letter d to have been input one step earlier (prev_tok=d: 15.5x lift, 68% of mass) or two steps earlier (prev2_tok=d: 6.7x). The strongest activations come from a double d (d d) at positions 3-5: the activation rises on the second d and peaks on the token after it. Sequences that start with j/g/k fire somewhat more often. It does not fire at t<=2, at t>=9, or in the copy phase. Outside these windows it fires weakly on many other contexts, which caps precision and recall near 0.55, but the predicate still captures about 81% of the activation mass and 97% of the top activation quartile.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: d, w, i, f, c, m; least: 1, p, j, g) and the input two steps back (most: d, w, i, f, h, c; least: n, 1, g, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=5, t=6, t=7.
